qualification: Every duration is provisional (PC shared). Native preference/guard and no-save assertions are separate from profiler validity. Whole-frame timings are separate. Strict gate uses p95 <5 ms and zero >=30 ms intervals.

windows.coverage_qualification: Union of the mod assembly's Unity messages (Update/LateUpdate/FixedUpdate/OnGUI, Start/OnDestroy, OnTrigger*/OnCollision* and the rest), its Harmony prefixes/postfixes/finalizers, the mod methods its transpilers inject into native IL, GlobalEvents and SceneManager subscribers and IModBigAmbitions methods, timed in place. Coroutines, worker threads and callbacks registered with other native events are not timed. Observer overhead of nested scopes stays inside the union.
